translations.web: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
translations.bsb: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a palace for him.
translations.kjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
translations.asv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar-trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
